requirement_compliance.title: Resource-budget circuit breaker for the monitor
requirement_compliance.evidence: Decide() pure CPU-high decision function pinned by TC-NM-008h (2 tests: engages at 6.5%, stays open at ≤6%). Token bucket, RAM sampler and priority pause cascade are skeleton (technical_debt: high effort).

requirement_compliance.title: Bufferbloat score (idle vs loaded latency)

requirement_compliance.title: Public IP tracking and change events
requirement_compliance.evidence: ValidatePublicIPEchoURL() pinned by TC-NM-011e (1 passing TC with 5 reject + 4 accept sub-cases) — closes the SSRF surface at settings save. Cadence loop and event emission are skeleton (technical_debt: low effort).

requirement_compliance.title: LAN device discovery (passive, low-cost)
requirement_compliance.evidence: Package boundary invariant (no gopacket/pcap imports anywhere in lan transitive deps) pinned by TC-NM-012e (1 passing). ARP reader, mDNS listener and virtual-interface filter are skeleton (technical_debt: high effort).

requirement_compliance.title: WiFi link metrics (Pi-side)
requirement_compliance.evidence: ParseProcWireless() pinned by TC-NM-013e (2 tests: parses fixture without helper.Call → applicable=true with rssi=-58, link_quality=70, retries=12; returns ErrProcWirelessNotApplicable for header-only input). Confirms FR-028 no-root invariant. iw helper invocation and Worker.Run lifecycle are skeleton (technical_debt: medium effort).

requirement_compliance.title: Path tracking (periodic traceroute)
requirement_compliance.evidence: BuildTracerouteArgs() pinned by TC-NM-014e (2 tests: returns exact ['-n','-m','30','1.1.1.1'] for valid IPv4; rejects 5 unsafe inputs including shell metacharacters, hostnames and flag-shaped strings via ErrInvalidTracerouteTarget). Helper allow-list grammar accepts exactly this shape. Worker.Run, hop-diff and path_changed event are skeleton (technical_debt: medium effort).

requirement_compliance.title: Performance — CPU/RSS/disk/WAN budgets
requirement_compliance.evidence: FR-023 Decide() locks the CPU-high threshold (>6% engages). Token bucket, RSS sampler and disk-growth retention sweep are skeleton (technical_debt: depends on FR-021 store and FR-020 compaction). No 24h soak harness in this iteration — TC-NM-026h declared integration but not yet implemented.

requirement_compliance.title: Reliability — graceful degradation and isolation
requirement_compliance.evidence: Per-class worker isolation, exponential backoff and recover()+restart pattern are declared in 02_SYSTEM_DESIGN.md but no test exercises them yet (TC-NM-024 series defined as integration, currently skipped). Pattern is structurally present in the package layout (one goroutine per probe class) but the failure-injection paths are not wired.

requirement_compliance.title: Security — privileged ops via FR-011 helper allow-list
requirement_compliance.evidence: Helper allow-list validator pinned by TC-NM-023h/f/e (3 passing) — covers the binary/flag closed-set check. Traceroute argv producer (BuildTracerouteArgs) is the single source for traceroute calls and pinned by TC-NM-014e. Helper RPC client and audit-log write path are skeleton (technical_debt).

requirement_compliance.title: Observability — structured probe log lines
requirement_compliance.evidence: Logger plumbed via Deps in network.go. Structured slog emission at probe call sites is not yet wired because workers are skeletons (technical_debt: low effort — lands with worker implementations). Log-format regex pinned in TC-NM-025h (currently skipped).

requirement_compliance.title: Security — auth+CSRF inheritance, no new public route
requirement_compliance.evidence: internal/network/api.Register attaches /network/* and /api/network/* to the parent mux only — the parent's FR-007 session and FR-012 CSRF middleware front the mux, so all new routes inherit those gates. No public unauthenticated route is introduced. Validation (TC-NM-021h/f/e in spec) currently skipped — wiring tested only at the routing-surface level.

requirement_compliance.title: CI/CD inheritance — parent pipeline builds/tests this feature
requirement_compliance.evidence: .github/workflows/security-gate.yml triggers on push and pull_request to main, sets up Go from go.mod, runs `go test ./...` (the manifest test_runner) and govulncheck. The new package set under internal/network/* is included transitively. No new pipeline introduced — NFR-010 satisfied by inheritance.
